learning_outcomes.text: Build a driver-based budget workbook with clearly separated inputs, calculations and outputs
Produce baseline forecasts using Excel trend and FORECAST.ETS functions and state their assumptions
Perform budget-versus-actual variance analysis and quantify favourable and adverse variances
Explain each variance with contributing factors a reviewer can trace to source data
Package budgeting outputs into a reviewable management report

integrative_case: A department head must present next year's budget: build a driver-based budget, forecast revenue and key costs with FORECAST.ETS, compare the first quarter's actuals, explain the three largest variances with traceable drivers, and summarise the result on one reviewable page.
assesses: knowledge and applied reasoning on every in-scope outcome via MCQ/MR
case-based decisions in the integrative case
